content:
Asha Patel: noticed p99 spike on streaming inference around 13:02 UTC, tail latency ~1.2s and a bunch of stalled streams. Grafana: spikes align with a surge in configfetch latency and auth token store >100ms calls.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED (sev=2) — 1772468101 — Inference streaming p99 breach; paging oncall.
Sam Oncall: I'm on it, grabbing logs. Can someone confirm customer impact? any errors surfaced to clients?
Olivia (Support): A few customer 5xxs reported, mostly streaming clients timing out. ~12 customers reported degraded streams, 3 customers flagged as high priority.
Marta SRE: quick triage — control-plane traces show feature-flag sync requests to config-store are piling up, feature-flag service is hitting rate limits to token-store. There's a hot path where each stream tries to fetch flag state on start.
Tom Nguyen: logs: 
```
ERROR inference/stream_manager.go: startStream: configfetch timeout (500ms) for flag=enable_conditional_shard
WARN auth/token_store.go: getToken: rate limit hit, backoff enforced
```
Seems like token-store is the bottleneck.
Priya Rao: also seeing KV cache misses for the prefix cache, likely due to frequent flag lookups invalidating cache. That increases control-plane calls per stream.
Asha Patel: hypothesis: recent rollout of flag sync change (rollout id 2026-03-10) introduced per-connection sync instead of batch. When traffic surged, token-store and configfetch spiked, which cascaded into streaming stalls.
Leah (PM): customer impact summary for handoff: ~12 customers affected, estimated 60k streams in 1h window, SLOs p95 within target but p99 exceeded by ~700ms. Likely customer visible for chatbots and streaming responses.
Sam Oncall: mitigation plan (short-term): 1) flip feature-flag to previous behavior (disable new per-connection sync), 2) apply emergency rate increase to token-store for internal traffic, 3) enable local cached fallback for flag lookup at stream start. Who can perform each?
Marta SRE: I can flip the flag via ffctl, and request token-store quota bump. Command: `ffctl set inference.per_connection_flag_sync false --env prod --reason "emergency rollback 1772468101"`
Tom Nguyen: I'll open an urgent request to infra to raise token-store rate windows and watch for retries: `infra-ops create-request --service token-store --delta-rps 2000 --urgency p1`
Priya Rao: I can push the local cached fallback config to streaming runtime (hot config) — quick patch: set `STREAM_FLAG_CACHE_TTL=30s` and `FLAG_FALLBACK=local-cache`. That avoids a roundtrip on start.
Asha Patel: quick impact/rollback check: flipping flag is minimally invasive. We should coordinate: flip flag, then enable STREAM_FLAG_CACHE_TTL, then observe for 2-3 autoscale cycles.
incident-bot: ACTION LOG — flag toggle requested by Marta SRE at 13:10 UTC.
Marta SRE: done — `ffctl` command applied, waiting for propagation. Watching metrics.
Tom Nguyen: infra accepted token-store bump request; applied in 60s. Watching error rates.
Priya Rao: applied hot config to streaming cluster: `kubectl set env deployment/stream-runtime STREAM_FLAG_CACHE_TTL=30s FLAG_FALLBACK=local-cache -n prod` — patch rolled to 3/4 pods, canary looks good.
Sam Oncall: metrics update: p99 dropped from ~1200ms to ~350ms within 90s of changes. Error rate falling. Reconnect counts down ~60%.
Olivia (Support): reached out to 3 affected customers with interim update. No escalations yet.
Asha Patel: root-cause notes: per-connection flag sync rollout caused amplified control-plane calls; token-store rate limits + KV cache churn produced cascading stalls.
Leah (PM): please capture timeline and customer list for post-incident note. We'll decide on communication once handoff is complete.
Marta SRE: next steps (mid-term): 1) revert rollout permanently or rework to batch sync, 2) instrument per-connection metrics, 3) add circuit-breaker to flag fetch path.
Tom Nguyen: infra follow-ups: analyze token-store rate-limit logs, consider autoscaling rules for token-store and config-store; add warm pools.
Priya Rao: we'll implement client-side batching for flag refresh in the next sprint, and add local pre-warm caches to streaming runtime.
Sam Oncall: lowering severity to P2, but keeping page live for 30m for observation. Handing off to Tom for overnight monitoring. Summary for handoff: 
- What happened: rollout introduced per-connection flag sync.
- Impact: p99 streaming latencies jumped by ~700-900ms, ~12 customers affected, 3 high-pri.
- Mitigations applied: emergency flag toggle (rolled back), token-store rate bump, streaming hot config cache TTL set.
- Current state: p99 back within acceptable window (~350ms), error rate trending down.
Tom Nguyen: taking over oncall. I'll keep chart watch and follow up with infra & eng tomorrow AM. If anything regresses ping me @tom.
incident-bot: HANDOFF — oncall transferred to Tom Nguyen at 13:45 UTC.
Marta SRE: adding postmortem checklist to the incident board. Will collect logs and diffs.
Leah (PM): we'll prepare a short customer note if any of the three high-pri customers request details. Good job team.
Olivia (Support): continuing customer outreach; will update when customers confirm restored.
Asha Patel: adding tags: `control-plane`, `token-store`, `feature-flag`, `streaming`, `sev2`. Closing thread for now; will reopen if regression.
